channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5) (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): The name ended '(Substation No. 5, relocated)'
item.description: The name ended '(Substation No. 5, relocated)'. The Pier 70 Design for Development lists the building as 'Building 21 Substation No. 5 (relocated)', but the move belongs to the building's history, which this record's text and facts already give, and not to its name. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=), PDF page 176, list of historic buildings: "Building 21 Substation No. 5 (relocated).".

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): The Building 21 page now cites the Port's…
item.description: The Building 21 page now cites the Port's memo dated Aug 3, 2017 (Item 11A) by its date. It no longer quotes the National Register nomination, which was not among its sources. It says the Port and the D4D call the building Substation No. 5, while the same memo dates it to the Risdon Iron Works period around 1900 and the Port's 2011 request for information calls it the former Risdon Ironworks Building, so sources give different original uses. Its 'mixed' use reflects the planned arts and institutional use, not a use sourced today. Source: Port Commission memo, Aug 3, 2017, Item 11A, Exhibit F (sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Pier%2070%20Final.pdf); Port Pier 70 RFI, 2011 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/FileCenter/Documents/939-Pier70_RFI_3-2-11_web.pdf).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): Building 21's description now says the…
item.description: Building 21's description now says the relocation about 75 feet to the southeast is planned as part of a rehabilitation that has not begun, rather than done (Port Item 9B, Sep 2017: 'would be relocated'); the map caveat says its position rests on satellite imagery and D4D figures, not on the Port's post-relocation wording; the 115,000 sq ft SF YIMBY figure is now described as covering Buildings 12 and 21 together; the retired Assessor lot 4052001 is described as a legacy id; and the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the phasing milestone. Two D4D photographs credited to Forest City / Shae Rocco and a D4D page containing such photos were removed because their credits show a private photographer and no reuse licence was found. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Pier 70 Special Use District Design for Development, updated 2022-04-26 (https://www.sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline=); SF YIMBY, 2021-10-27 (https://sfyimby.com/2021/10/new-renderings-for-parcel-a-development-agreement-filed-for-pier-70-san-francisco.html); Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2026-08-11 (https://www.sfport.com/media/11558/download?inline); DataSF Parcels (https://data.sf.gov/d/acdm-wktn).

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): Building 21 changed from Complete to Existing
item.description: Building 21 changed from Complete to Existing. No source shows its rehabilitation finished; the Port's own site page lists 'Rehabilitation of three historic buildings' among the project's planned features and shows a rendering of Building 21 (wording corrected 2026-09-29: the page doesn't itself say which buildings remain). Source: sfport.com Pier 70 28-acre site page.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): Port staff report for the… (Aug 11, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report for the Commission's Aug 11, 2026 meeting (informational item, no action; report dated Aug 7) shows the proposed phasing plan placing Building 21 with Parcels E1 and E4 in Phase 2C (Aug 11, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): Resolution 20-07 recites that… (Feb 11, 2020)
item.description: Resolution 20-07 recites that Historic Buildings 12 and 21 are excluded from the developer's general purchase/lease option (Feb 11, 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2020-02-11.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Building 21 (Substation No. 5): DDA terms approved: a vertical… (Sep 26, 2017)
item.description: DDA terms approved: a vertical developer affiliate must enter a 66-year lease for Building 21 within a year after completion of the building on Parcel E-1 and seek historic tax credits; base rent $1/year, participation rent 3.5% of modified gross income from year 31 after TCO (Sep 26, 2017). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22.
